So, long time no see, huh? I always wanted to do blogging, but I never had a topic to write a blog on at all for some reason, anyways, I am here to announce I have as second website now.

Go visit it at freelolis.com, I will be having my info updated on there quicker, this website you are on right now will still be used for blogging when I feel like it.

Please note that freelolis.com also includes a series of Minecraft servers!

Love you all!
title: Secondary website for Sara
